openjlpt.levelPolicy: Community study classifications; not an official exhaustive JLPT syllabus.
openjlpt.adaptations: Selected word fields, reviewed alternative spellings, preserved existing entries, shared Chinese character references; no examples or grammar imported.

makemeahanzi.adaptations: Selected character fields, structural/semantic/phonetic links, shared radical forms, tone-mark pinyin without umlauts. Glyph-origin hints are source explanations; written structures are explicitly labelled.

wiktionary.attribution: Wiktionary contributors; entry-specific source URLs below.
wiktionary.adaptations: Short glyph-origin excerpts and compact structural summaries for missing components.

japanese-character-equivalences.adaptations: Individually selected old/new character identity facts; no automatic regional text conversion or wholesale table import.
